title: What 5D Optical Data Storage Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: 5D optical data storage writes data into glass using five dimensions: the usual three spatial dimensions plus the size and orientation of nanostructures. A femtosecond laser writes self-assembled nanogratings inside fused quartz, encoding multiple bits per voxel — archival storage that survives millennia. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for 5D Optical Data Storage: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: 5D Optical Data Storage in one line: 5D optical data storage writes data into glass using five dimensions: the usual three spatial dimensions plus the size and orientation of nanostructures.
Why it matters: Glass does not decay: it promises thousand-year archives immune to heat, water, and electromagnetic pulses..
Where it is used: civilizational archives, cultural heritage, legal and scientific records, deep backup..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.

t: Current Research State of 5D Optical Data Storage
title: Current Research State of 5D Optical Data Storage
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: University teams demonstrated 360 TB per disc capacity, 1,000-year thermal stability, and readout at high speed; the technology was famously used to store human-genome and cultural documents in quartz. Research now targets write speed (currently slow), parallel writing, and drive cost. It remains a write-rarely, read-occasionally archival medium. Research moves in three waves: laboratory proof of concept, scaled prototypes under controlled conditions, and field trials. 5D Optical Data Storage currently sits at the stage described above, and the pieces records show what each wave still needs.
